messages:
rajan: Morning team — I've got a flight Tuesday morning (5:30am) and can't cover the 6am–10am oncall window. Can someone swap with me? I can take Fri night (22:00–02:00) instead. TL;DR: need swap for Tue 6–10am. :wave:

sophia: I can do Tue 6–10am. happy to take it. Will need handoff notes.

rajan: awesome, thanks! I'll leave a short handoff. important: we have the model deployment scheduled Mon 23:30 — if it rolls past midnight there may be transient 503s. Don't restart inference nodes unless Eng-Infra ok.

oncall-bot: Rotation reminder — rajan -> sophia swap pending. Please confirm with :thumbsup:

sophia: :thumbsup: confirmed. Can you paste runbook steps for failing nodes?

rajan: runbook snippet:
```
1) check pods: kubectl -n redwood get pods -l app=inference
2) if OOM/killed, kubectl describe pod <pod>
3) restart pod: kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference --namespace redwood
```
Also check redis cache: `redis-cli -h cache.internal ping` If you hit >50% CPU, route to fallback model via console route 'fallback-small'.

devops-jen: FYI if you need to scale, don't exceed 10 replicas during the deploy window; autoscaler is conservative.

sophia: thanks. I'll keep an eye on the deploy and report to #incidents if anything odd.

rajan: I'll DM the deployment owner (liam) to coordinate canary timing. Also leaving two quick notes: a) contact for customer A is out-of-office, B will be covering; b) incident channel subscription is set to 'oncall-sophia'.

liam: pinged — canary remains 4% then 20% at +30m. If you see an error spike, pause canary and alert me.

sophia: got it. Any monitoring dashboards I should watch?

rajan: watch 'inference/latency' and 'inference/error-rate' in console. thresholds: >100ms p95 OR error-rate >1% -> escalate. I left a small gist with checks: https://gist.github.com/xxxxx/hand-off

sophia: thanks, leaving a note on the rotation calendar. I'll update the thread if anything comes up before Tuesday.

rajan: super appreciated. Also toggle MFA for oncall access? make sure you have HSM key access — ping security if not.

security-bot: Reminder — oncall access requires 2FA + KMS token. If you need temporary access, open a ticket.

sophia: all set. :rocket:
